attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The same day's calendar keeps a second Antonius, the son of Melasippus and Cassine of Ancyra, in a separate entry with a passion of his own; the two are not the same man and this one is named for his brother. The page gives him no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
